title: Inverse-image ideal annihilation of a transported categorical formal kernel
statement: Let $j:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion of Noetherian schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion], let $Q$ be a quasi-coherent ideal [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], and choose any Abelian structure on $\mathit{Coh}(X,Q)$ [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-modules-abelian]. Let $M,N$ belong to $\mathit{Coh}(X,Q)$ and $G,D$ to $\mathit{Coh}(Z,Q\mathcal O_Z)$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. Given $a:M\to N$, $\alpha:G\to D$, and inverse-system isomorphisms $e:M\cong j_*G$, $d:N\cong j_*D$ satisfying $d\circ a=(j_*\alpha)\circ e$, let $L$ be a quasi-coherent ideal on $Z$, $t\geq0$, and $k$ any limiting kernel fork of $\alpha$. If $L^t$ annihilates every term of its point, then the inverse-image ideal $(L^t).\operatorname{map}(j)$ annihilates every term of $\operatorname{Ker}(a)$. Here ideal powers and their module products are those of [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-module-product-stalk], and map is the kernel ideal of the composite $(L^t).\mathrm{subscheme}\to Z\to X$. No proper-support or nonempty-complement hypothesis is required.

source.place: Theorem 088E, closed quotient replacement and final comparison; Tags 087T, 087W, 087X for closed coherent equivalence and affine/local description of categorical formal kernels. Verified at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/088E and the corresponding tag pages.

proof.text: Apply the categorical formal-kernel comparison to the given limiting fork and commuting square. This yields an inverse-system isomorphism from kernel(a) to the pushed kernel.

At each index the coherent terms of the two formal systems are quasi-coherent by the locally Noetherian coherence criterion. Apply closedImmersion_idealPower_annihilation to the component of the comparison isomorphism and hkill at that index.

lean.statement:
theorem closedImmersion_formalKernel_annihilated
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Z]
    (j : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion j] (Q : X.IdealSheafData)
    [Abelian (CoherentFormalModule X Q)]
    (M N : CoherentFormalModule X Q)
    (G D : CoherentFormalModule Z (Q.comap j))
    (a : M ⟶ N) (α : G ⟶ D)
    (e : M.obj ≅ G.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward j)
    (d : N.obj ≅ D.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward j)
    (hsquare : a.hom ≫ d.hom =
      e.hom ≫ Functor.whiskerRight α.hom (Scheme.Modules.pushforward j))
    (L : Z.IdealSheafData) (t : ℕ) (k : KernelFork α) (hk : IsLimit k)
    (hkill : ∀ n : ℕ, IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct
      (Scheme.idealSheafPower L.toModulesι t).2 (k.pt.obj.obj (op n)))) :
    AnnihilatedBy Q ((L ^ t).map j) (kernel a)
